# SFINCS Individual Contributor License Agreement

> **DRAFT v0.1 for review by Deltares Legal. Not yet in force.**
> Structure adapted from the Apache Software Foundation Individual CLA v2.2.
> The outbound-licensing clause (section 2.3) and the past-contributions clause (section 1, "Contribution") are Deltares additions.

Thank you for your interest in contributing to SFINCS, which is owned and maintained by Stichting Deltares, Boussinesqweg 1, 2629 HV Delft, the Netherlands (KvK number [TO BE FILLED IN]) ("Deltares").

To keep the legal status of SFINCS clear, and so that Deltares can continue to distribute SFINCS under more than one licence, Deltares needs every contributor to accept this Agreement. It protects you as a contributor as well as Deltares and the users of SFINCS. It does not change your right to use your own Contributions for any other purpose.

You accept this Agreement by signing it electronically, as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), or by signing a copy and sending it to sfincs@deltares.nl.

## 1. Definitions

**"You"** (or **"Your"**) means the natural person who accepts this Agreement. If You make Contributions as part of your employment or under a contract with an organisation that owns or may claim rights in Your Contributions, that organisation must sign the SFINCS Entity Contributor License Agreement before You submit those Contributions (see section 4).

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any modifications or additions to an existing work, that You submit to Deltares for inclusion in, or documentation of, SFINCS or any other project owned or managed by Deltares under the name SFINCS (the "Work"). This includes source code, documentation, test cases, configuration files, figures and examples. "Submit" means any form of electronic, verbal or written communication sent to Deltares or its representatives, including pull requests, patches, issue comments containing code, and e-mail, but excluding communication that You conspicuously mark as "Not a Contribution". **This Agreement applies to all Contributions You have submitted before accepting it as well as all Contributions You submit afterwards.**

2.1 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, You grant Deltares, and recipients of software distributed by Deltares, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright licence to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense and distribute Your Contributions and such derivative works.

2.2 This licence covers all forms of exploitation, including forms not yet known when this Agreement is accepted, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

2.3 **Outbound licensing.** Deltares may distribute Your Contributions, alone or as part of the Work, under any licence terms of its choice, including open-source licences other than the licence the Work is distributed under when You submit the Contribution, and including proprietary or commercial licences. Deltares will keep making the Contributions available under at least one licence approved by the Open Source Initiative for as long as Deltares distributes the Work as open source. 2.4 You keep the copyright in Your Contributions. Except for the licences granted in this Agreement, You reserve all right, title and interest in and to Your Contributions.

## 3. Patent licence

Subject to the terms of this Agreement, You grant Deltares, and recipients of software distributed by Deltares, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable (except as stated in this section) patent licence to make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import and otherwise transfer the Work. This licence applies only to those patent claims that You can license and that are necessarily infringed by Your Contribution(s) alone, or by combining Your Contribution(s) with the Work to which they were submitted. If any entity starts patent litigation against You or any other entity (including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit), alleging that Your Contribution, or the Work to which You have contributed, constitutes direct or contributory patent infringement, then all patent licences granted to that entity under this Agreement for that Contribution or Work end on the date that litigation is filed.

## 4. Your representations

4.1 You represent that You are legally entitled to grant the above licences.

4.2 If Your employer(s), or an organisation You work for under contract, has rights to intellectual property that You create, including Your Contributions, You represent that either:
(a) You have received permission to make Contributions on behalf of that organisation and that organisation has signed the SFINCS Entity Contributor License Agreement; or
(b) that organisation has waived its rights in Your Contributions to SFINCS.

4.3 You represent that each of Your Contributions is Your original creation (see section 6 for submissions on behalf of others).

4.4 You represent that, to Your knowledge, Your Contributions do not infringe any third party's copyright, patent, trade secret or other intellectual property right. You agree to include with every Contribution complete details of any third-party licence or other restriction (including related patents and trademarks) that You know of and that applies to any part of Your Contribution.

## 5. No obligations

5.1 You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to the extent You wish to. Unless required by applicable law or agreed in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, express or implied, including any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

5.2 Deltares is under no obligation to include any Contribution in the Work.

## 6. Work that is not Your own

If You wish to submit work that is not Your original creation, You may submit it to Deltares separately from any Contribution. Identify the complete details of its source and of any licence or other restriction (including related patents, trademarks and licence agreements) that You know of, and conspicuously mark the work as "Submitted on behalf of a third party: [named here]".

## 7. Notification

You agree to notify Deltares (sfincs@deltares.nl) of any facts or circumstances You become aware of that would make these representations inaccurate in any respect.

## 8. Moral rights

To the extent permitted by applicable law, You agree not to invoke Your moral rights in a way that would prevent Deltares from exercising the licences granted in this Agreement, such as making reasonable modifications to Your Contributions. [LEGAL: check wording against Auteurswet art. 25.]

## 9. Governing law and jurisdiction

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Netherlands. Any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement will be submitted exclusively to the competent court in The Hague, the Netherlands. [LEGAL: confirm court.]

## 10. Changes to this Agreement

Deltares may publish new versions of this Agreement. A new version applies only to Contributions You submit after You have accepted that new version. Contributions submitted under an earlier version remain covered by that version.
